result:
I checked each claim against the brand policy.

- **"Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website"**: matches the allowlist exactly. Fine.
- **"packed by hand in Bristol"**: allowed (every tin is packed by hand in Bristol). Fine.
- **"organic"**: backed by Soil Association certification. Fine, though naming the certifier would be stronger.
- **"loose leaf"**: product fact. Fine.
- **"The finest"**: an unsupported superlative. Nothing in the policy backs a claim that the tea is the best or of the highest quality. Remove it or replace it with a factual descriptor.
- **"eco-friendly bags"**: a vague green claim. The policy supports the specific claims "plastic-free" and "home compostable", but not the generic "eco-friendly". Replace it with "plastic-free, home compostable tea bags".

Suggested rewrite: "Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website. Certified organic loose leaf tea and plastic-free, home compostable tea bags, packed by hand in Bristol."
